**Not ready to publish.** Two claims have no support in the allowlist.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Tea that's easy to stop and start" | Fine as a plain restatement of the pause/cancel terms |
| "Most subscribers stay with us for over a year" | **Unsupported.** It is a retention statistic and nothing in the policy backs it. |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | Allowlisted (subscription terms) |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | Allowlisted (shipping policy) |
| "means most boxes ship free" | **Unsupported.** It implies most orders exceed £25, which we have no data for. The free-delivery threshold is the only claim we can make. |

No health, green, superlative, guarantee or urgency claims. No banned voice words and no AI-tell structures. A hero on our own page needs no "Ad" or "Gifted" label.

**Suggested replacement**

> Tea you can pause or cancel any time. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

If the retention figure is real, send me the source (e.g. a subscription data export with the date) and I can work it in. Sam still needs to approve the final copy before it goes live.
